summary: Neither prerequisite for a staging deployment exists in this environment: no cloud Supabase test project is linked or authorized, and no hosting provider is configured. Both are the same open, external blockers (B3, B4) recorded in release/backlog.json; this record is a dated, evidence-backed re-confirmation, not a new finding.

evidence: ~/.supabase/ contains only telemetry.json and traces/ — no access-token file
supabase/.temp/ contains no project-ref file (never linked to a cloud project)

npx supabase projects list -> {"_tag":"Error","error":{"code":"LegacyPlatformAuthRequiredError","message":"Access token not provided. Supply an access token by running `supabase login` or setting the SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN environment variable."}}
npm run doctor -> CONFIG_URL_LOCAL: configured Supabase URL is http://127.0.0.1:54321 (local); no hosted/test project URL is configured anywhere in the browser-facing config either
No vercel.json, netlify.toml, render.yaml, fly.toml, or wrangler.toml in the repository
vercel, netlify, and wrangler CLIs are not on PATH
VERCEL_TOKEN, NETLIFY_AUTH_TOKEN, CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN, FLY_API_TOKEN: all unset
DASHBOARD_SUPABASE_PROJECT_URL and DASHBOARD_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY (the build-time browser-public inputs required for any artifact build) are unset

notPerformed: config/supabase-config.local.js and config/data-config.local.js were not read: both are secret-protected local files (Read denied by .claude/settings.json), and the doctor check already answers the material question — the configured project is local, not a hosted test project.

GitHub Actions repository secrets were not queried (gh secret list is denied unconditionally in .claude/settings.json regardless of read/write). They are a CI-only credential surface in any case, not usable for an interactive supabase link or a local frontend build.
action: Stop, per AGENTS.md and the task instruction: 'If required staging access is missing, record one precise external blocker in the release state and stop.' No cloud action, database action, or deployment was attempted. Resolving this needs a human operator: create or nominate a test-only Supabase project and run `npx supabase login` interactively (B3), and choose a static host and provide its credentials (B4) — both already recorded as Product Owner actions in docs/test-environment-status.md.
